title: should render the toolbar with four tabs and Overview active by default
verifies: the toolbar and four-tab toggle group render with Overview active and the Overview child resolves (not stuck loading)

title: should navigate the route and mount the matching child for each tab
verifies: clicking each tab updates the URL to the matching child route, mounts the child dashboard, and tracks the active tab

title: should back-sync the active tab when deep-linking to a child route
verifies: opening a child route directly auto-selects the matching tab and mounts its dashboard

title: should re-run the Overview dashboard on manual refresh without hanging
verifies: the refresh button re-runs the dashboard and the loading indicator resolves without hanging

title: Auto-Run / Live-Mode toggle — not wired in the default E2E env: auto_query_enabled defaults to false (src/config/src/config.rs:2487), so the refresh-options dropdown and toggle never render (web/src/composables/dashboard/useAutoRunToggle.ts:38, web/src/views/RUM/AppPerformance.vue:81)
verifies: documented feature-gap (fixme): the config-gated Auto-Run toggle flips the stored flag once ZO_AUTO_QUERY_ENABLED=true

title: should copy the current route URL when the share-link button is clicked
verifies: the share-link button copies a short URL and shows the Link Copied toast (skipped when web_url is unset)

title: should collapse the tab strip into a dropdown on mobile and navigate
verifies: a narrow viewport collapses the tabs into a dropdown that still navigates to the matching child route
